sourceover_validation.notes: All nine true SourceOver composites keep a clean, tight silhouette. The cyan-teal life core, concentric return loops, and increasing star-node progression remain clear at 64px; the loop-plus-life-core silhouette remains readable at 32px. The main agent separately reviewed the 256px, 64px, and 32px game-indigo composites and accepted the icon.

main_agent_review.scope: static actual-size SourceOver review; not an in-game runtime capture

adaptation.operation: prepare_vivhite_ui_icon.gd performed only uniform RGBA Lanczos resize plus centered transparent padding; no thresholding, mask, color key, Alpha repair, erosion, expansion, or creative post-processing.

decision: Attempt 01 satisfies the static transparent-icon contract and passed the main agent's three-size game-indigo SourceOver review. Stop at 1/8 attempts; no retry requested. Actual in-game runtime validation remains part of the later full integration pass.
